def.short: to travel regularly between your home and your work or school
def.long: To travel regularly between your home and your place of work or school. Some people do it by train for an hour each way.

examples.en: I commute to work by train every day.
examples.tr: Her gün işe trenle gidip geliyorum.

examples.en: She commutes two hours each way.
examples.tr: Her gün gidişte de dönüşte de iki saat yol yapıyor.

examples.en: Many people commute from the suburbs into the city.
examples.tr: Birçok insan banliyölerden şehre işe gidip geliyor.

etymology.text: From the 19th-century American 'commutation ticket': a cheaper ticket for people who traveled every day. 'Commute' comes from Latin 'commutare' ('to exchange').

tr.note: Türkçede tek kelimelik karşılığı yok. 'Commute' düzenli yapılan, genelde uzun gidiş-gelişi anlatır; tek seferlik yolculuk için 'travel' veya 'go' kullanılır.

mistakes.wrong: I commute to work with the metro.
mistakes.right: I commute to work by metro.
mistakes.why: Türkçede 'metroyla' dendiği için 'with' kullanılır; ama araç için 'by' (the yok) denir: by metro, by bus.

quiz.cloze: I ______ to work by train; it takes about an hour each way.

def.short: the time of day when most people travel to or from work
def.long: The time of day, usually in the morning and early evening, when many people travel to or from work and the roads and trains are very full.

examples.en: Avoid the subway at rush hour if you can.
examples.tr: Mümkünse yoğun saatlerde metroya binme.

examples.en: It's rush hour, so the roads are full.
examples.tr: Şu an en yoğun saatler, o yüzden yollar dolu.

examples.en: We left at ten to miss the morning rush hour.
examples.tr: Sabah trafiğine takılmamak için saat onda çıktık.

tr.note: Genelde sabah 7-9 ve akşam 17-19 arasıdır. İngilizcede 'hour' dese de bir saatten uzun sürer. Çoğul 'rush hours' da kullanılır.

quiz.cloze: The train is always crowded at ______ because everyone goes to work.

def.short: a place where two or more roads cross each other
def.long: A place where two or more roads cross each other. Cars must slow down or stop here, and there are often traffic lights. British English also says 'junction'.

examples.en: Turn left at the next intersection.
examples.tr: Bir sonraki kavşakta sola dönün.

examples.en: There was an accident at the intersection.
examples.tr: Kavşakta bir kaza oldu.

examples.en: This is a dangerous intersection, so drive slowly.
examples.tr: Burası tehlikeli bir kavşak, o yüzden yavaş sür.

tr.note: ABD'de 'intersection', İngiltere'de 'junction' denir. Daire şeklindeki dönel kavşak için 'roundabout' kullanılır.

quiz.cloze: The traffic light at that ______ is always red when I'm late.

def.short: a person who is walking, not in a car or on a bike
def.long: A person who walks in the street or on a road, and is not in a car or on a bus. Drivers must stop for them at a crossing.

examples.en: Drivers must stop for pedestrians.
examples.tr: Sürücüler yayalar için durmak zorunda.

examples.en: Pedestrians should use the bridge to cross the highway.
examples.tr: Yayalar otoyolu geçmek için köprüyü kullanmalı.

examples.en: The street was full of pedestrians on Saturday.
examples.tr: Sokak cumartesi günü yayalarla doluydu.

etymology.text: From Latin 'pedester' ('going on foot'), from 'pes, ped-' (foot). The same root is in 'pedal'.

quiz.cloze: Cars must stop at the crossing when a ______ is waiting.

def.micro: area at the edge of a city
def.short: a quiet area at the edge of a city, where many people live
def.long: An area at the edge of a big city, usually with houses and gardens instead of tall buildings. Many people live there and travel into the city for work.

examples.en: We live in a quiet suburb of Ankara.
examples.tr: Ankara'nın sakin bir banliyösünde yaşıyoruz.

examples.en: Houses in the suburbs are cheaper than in the center.
examples.tr: Banliyödeki evler merkezdekilerden daha ucuz.

examples.en: He drives from the suburbs to the city every day.
examples.tr: Her gün banliyöden şehre arabayla gidiyor.

tr.note: 'Suburb' genelde evleri ve bahçeleri olan sakin bir bölgedir. Türkçedeki 'varoş' çoğu zaman düşük gelirli bölge çağrışımı taşır; 'suburb' bu anlamı taşımaz.

quiz.cloze: We moved to a ______ because we wanted a house with a garden.

def.micro: warm and wet in the air
def.short: with a lot of water in the air, so it feels warm and sticky
def.long: With a lot of water in the air, so the weather feels hot and sticky. It is common near the sea in summer.

examples.en: It's very humid today. I'm sweating.
examples.tr: Bugün hava çok nemli. Terliyorum.

examples.en: Summers in Antalya are hot and humid.
examples.tr: Antalya'da yazlar sıcak ve nemlidir.

examples.en: The air was so humid that my shirt got wet.
examples.tr: Hava o kadar nemliydi ki tişörtüm ıslandı.

tr.note: 'Humid' havadaki nemi anlatır. 'Wet' (ıslak) ve 'damp' (hafif ıslak, soğuk) ile karıştırmayın. Nem oranı = humidity.

quiz.cloze: It's hot and ______ in summer, so my clothes feel sticky.

def.short: a period of several days or weeks of very hot weather
def.long: A period of several days or weeks when the weather is much hotter than normal. People are told to drink water and stay out of the sun.

examples.en: There is a heatwave this week, so drink a lot of water.
examples.tr: Bu hafta sıcak hava dalgası var, bol su iç.

examples.en: The heatwave lasted ten days.
examples.tr: Sıcak hava dalgası on gün sürdü.

examples.en: Many people stayed inside during the heatwave.
examples.tr: Sıcak hava dalgası boyunca birçok kişi evde kaldı.

tr.note: Haberlerde 'sıcak hava dalgası', günlük dilde 'aşırı sıcaklar' denir. Soğuk için karşılığı 'cold snap' (soğuk hava dalgası) kullanılır.

quiz.cloze: The ______ was so strong that many shops closed for a week.

def.short: a large amount of water that covers land that is usually dry
def.long: A large amount of water that covers land that is usually dry, often after very heavy rain. It can damage houses, roads, and cars.

examples.en: The heavy rain caused a flood in the village.
examples.tr: Şiddetli yağmur köyde sele neden oldu.

examples.en: The flood closed the main road for two days.
examples.tr: Sel, ana yolu iki gün kapattı.

examples.en: They had to leave their house because of the flood.
examples.tr: Sel yüzünden evlerini terk etmek zorunda kaldılar.

tr.note: 'Sel' yağmurdan veya nehirden taşan su, 'su baskını' ise bodrum, ev veya yolun suyla dolmasıdır. İngilizcede ikisi için de 'flood' kullanılır.

quiz.cloze: After three days of heavy rain, there was a ______ in the town.

def.short: cold enough to feel uncomfortable, but not very cold
def.long: Rather cold, so you feel uncomfortable without a jacket. It is colder than cool, but not as cold as freezing.

examples.en: It's a bit chilly tonight. Take a jacket.
examples.tr: Bu gece hava biraz serin. Bir ceket al.

examples.en: The water was too chilly to swim in.
examples.tr: Su yüzmek için fazla soğuktu.

examples.en: Mornings are chilly in October.
examples.tr: Ekimde sabahlar serin olur.

tr.note: 'Serin' ile 'soğuk' arasında, üşütecek kadar serin demektir. Kişinin hissini de anlatır: 'I feel chilly' = Üşüyorum.

quiz.cloze: Take a sweater with you. The evenings are ______ in autumn.

def.short: to wake up later than you planned
def.long: To wake up later than you planned, usually because you slept too deeply or your alarm did not ring. It often makes people late for work or school.

examples.en: I overslept and missed the bus.
examples.tr: Uyuyakaldım ve otobüsü kaçırdım.

examples.en: She overslept, so she was late for the exam.
examples.tr: Uyuyakaldığı için sınava geç kaldı.

examples.en: Set two alarms so you don't oversleep.
examples.tr: Uyuyakalmamak için iki alarm kur.

tr.note: Düzensiz fiil: oversleep – overslept – overslept. 'Sleep in' ise bilerek geç kalkmaktır (pazar sabahı gibi); 'oversleep' istemeden olur.

mistakes.why: Fiil düzensizdir: geçmiş zaman 'overslept' (sleep – slept gibi). '-ed' eklenmez.

quiz.cloze: My alarm didn't ring, so I ______ and was late for work.
